metadata.scope: All 128 curated mappings across 5 programme layers.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Full immunization coverage rate
reviews.rationale: The routine HMIS manifestation measures the same broad construct, but uses estimated children below one year, children aged 9–11 months in the numerator and a historical antigen schedule.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Children 9–11 months fully immunised to children 9–11 months due for immunisation
reviews.rationale: The programme scorecard manifestation compares fully immunised children aged 9–11 months with children of the same age due for immunisation, but the cited table does not publish a complete operational formula.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Children aged 9–11 months due for immunisation

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Full Immunization
reviews.rationale: The survey-based scorecard label represents the same broad construct but applies to children aged 12–23 months and does not publish a computation in the cited table.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Children aged 12-23 months fully vaccinated
reviews.rationale: The household-survey manifestation is conceptually aligned, but differs from routine reporting in sampling, recall or card evidence, survey reference period and the survey-defined vaccination series.
reviews.sourcePage: See linked official source; page/table varies by edition

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Planned immunization sessions held
reviews.rationale: This is the closest percentage manifestation of sessions conducted among sessions planned, but the registry record does not preserve the operational form, exclusions or monitoring period needed for pooling.
reviews.sourceName: India — Universal Immunization Programme / Mission Indradhanush
reviews.sourcePage: See linked official source; page/table varies by edition

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Sessions held as per plan
reviews.rationale: The official IMI item is a count of sessions held as planned. It supports adherence analysis but is not itself an adherence proportion without a planned-session denominator.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Not applicable—absolute number of sessions held as planned

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percentage of sessions found held among monitored HRAs (can be generated by type of HRAs)
reviews.rationale: This is a narrower manifestation restricted to monitored high-risk areas and planned sessions actually selected for monitoring; the target concept is broader.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Planned sessions monitored in high-risk areas

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Immunization sessions with vaccine stock-out
reviews.rationale: Stock-out is directionally inverse to availability and may use a different vaccine basket, observation window and session denominator; it should not be treated as a direct synonym.
reviews.sourceName: India — Universal Immunization Programme / Mission Indradhanush
reviews.sourcePage: See linked official source; page/table varies by edition

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Availability of vaccines
reviews.rationale: The IMI monitoring item directly assesses vaccine availability, but the source list does not specify the numerator rule, required vaccine basket or treatment of partial availability.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Reason analysis on non-availability of any vaccine
reviews.rationale: Reason analysis explains non-availability among affected sessions; it is a categorical diagnostic, not an availability measure.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Monitored session sites where one or more vaccines were unavailable

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Adverse events following immunization reported
reviews.rationale: Reported AEFI case count reflects surveillance output and event occurrence, not performance by itself; a higher count is not unambiguously better or worse.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Not applicable—absolute count, source reporting element, or source-defined value
reviews.sourceName: India — Universal Immunization Programme / Mission Indradhanush
reviews.sourcePage: See linked official source; page/table varies by edition

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percent of AEFI cases line listed
reviews.rationale: Line-listing completeness is one narrower documentation component of the broader AEFI surveillance-performance concept.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percent of Serious AEFI cases reported on time
reviews.rationale: Timely reporting of serious AEFI cases is one narrower timeliness component of the broader performance concept.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percent serious AEFI cases with Case Reporting Form (CRF) shared with the state and centre on time
reviews.rationale: Timely sharing of the Case Reporting Form is one narrower documentation-flow component of the broader performance concept.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Serious AEFI cases requiring a Case Reporting Form

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percent of Serious AEFI cases investigated on time
reviews.rationale: Timely investigation of serious cases is one narrower investigation-timeliness component of the broader performance concept.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percent of Serious AEFI cases with completed investigation
reviews.rationale: Completed investigation is one narrower completeness component of the broader performance concept and is distinct from investigation timeliness.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percent of Serious AEFI cases classified for causality by the state AEFI Committee on time
reviews.rationale: Timely causality classification by the relevant committee is one narrower endpoint component of the broader surveillance-performance concept.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Serious AEFI cases eligible for causality classification

reviews.officialIndicatorName: BCG - measles dropout rates
reviews.rationale: The historical HMIS BCG-to-measles dropout percentage is a narrower antigen-pair manifestation; the target dropout concept is broader.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: DPT3 - Measles dropout rate
reviews.rationale: The historical HMIS DPT3-to-measles dropout percentage is a narrower antigen-pair manifestation; the target dropout concept is broader.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Total number of dropouts
reviews.rationale: Absolute dropout count supports programme action but is not equivalent to a percentage and cannot be compared without the first-dose cohort size.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Not applicable—absolute difference between first-dose and later-dose cumulative totals
reviews.sourceName: India — Routine Immunization handbook for medical officers

reviews.officialIndicatorName: BCG- Penta 3 dropout rate
reviews.rationale: BCG-to-Penta-3 dropout is a narrower antigen-pair manifestation of the broader dropout concept.
reviews.sourceName: India — Routine Immunization handbook for medical officers

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Penta 1- Penta 3 dropout rate
reviews.rationale: Penta-1-to-Penta-3 dropout is a narrower within-series manifestation of the broader dropout concept.
reviews.sourceName: India — Routine Immunization handbook for medical officers

reviews.officialIndicatorName: BCG-MCV1 dropout rate
reviews.rationale: BCG-to-MCV1 dropout is a narrower antigen-pair manifestation of the broader dropout concept.
reviews.sourceName: India — Routine Immunization handbook for medical officers

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Early registration rate
reviews.rationale: The HMIS measure represents early registration but its operational timing and reporting denominator remain source-version dependent.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: 1 Trimester registration to total ANC registration
differences: source table does not publish full operational exclusions
reviews.rationale: The scorecard expresses first-trimester registration among total ANC registrations; source-table computation detail is limited.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: ANC 3 checkups rate
reviews.rationale: The HMIS rate uses total ANC registered as denominator and the historic three-check-up schedule.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Pregnant women received 3 ANC to total ANC registration
reviews.rationale: The scorecard label describes the same broad construct but does not preserve complete operational exclusions.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Institutional delivery Rate (Public facilities )
reviews.rationale: This manifestation is restricted to public facilities, so the target concept is broader.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Institutional delivery Rate
reviews.rationale: The construct aligns, but estimated deliveries and routine reporting differ from scorecard populations.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Institutional deliveries to total ANC registration
reviews.rationale: The numerator is institutional deliveries but the denominator is total ANC registration rather than estimated deliveries.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Skilled Birth Attendant (SBA) Delivery Rate
reviews.rationale: Routine reported deliveries and the HMIS cadre definition differ from survey assessment.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Skilled Birth Attendance (Delivery by Doctor, ANM/Nurse/LHV)
reviews.rationale: The survey-based manifestation uses births assessed by a survey and a specified cadre list.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Neonatal mortality rate
reviews.rationale: Routine reported neonatal deaths may not represent all population deaths and must not be pooled with survey estimates.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Neonatal mortality rate
reviews.rationale: The same rate concept is represented through a survey scorecard with different ascertainment and reference period.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Contraceptive prevalence Rate (all methods)
reviews.rationale: Routine service reporting uses eligible couples and all methods as defined by HMIS.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Eligible couples using a modern contraceptive method
reviews.rationale: This manifestation is limited to modern methods and its programme-defined eligible population.
reviews.sourcePage: See linked official source; page/table varies by edition

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Contraceptive prevalence rate among married adolescents
reviews.rationale: The manifestation is restricted to married adolescents, so it is narrower than the target concept.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Mothers who received postnatal care from a doctor/nurse/LHV/ANM/other health personnel within 2 days of delivery for their last birth (%)
reviews.rationale: The manifestation specifies care within two days for the last birth and a survey-defined provider group.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Mothers with a last birth assessed by the survey

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Low birth weight rate
reviews.rationale: The denominator includes only live births weighed, so missing birth weights affect interpretation.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percentage of adolescents with any anaemia (<12.0 g/dl)
reviews.rationale: Any anaemia is one severity formulation within the broader anaemia concept.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Percentage of adolescents with severe anaemia (<7.0 g/dl)
reviews.rationale: Severe anaemia is one severity formulation within the broader anaemia concept.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Proportion of TB cases notified against estimated target
reviews.rationale: Target achievement is one manifestation of notification performance.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Target number of TB patients estimated to be notified

reviews.officialIndicatorName: TB notification target achievement - public and private sectors
reviews.rationale: This manifestation combines public and private notification targets.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Estimated public and private TB notification target
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 10 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Annualized TB case notification rate
reviews.rationale: An annualized population rate is analytically related but not equivalent to target achievement.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Gram Panchayat TB notification rate
reviews.rationale: This is a Gram Panchayat-specific rate and is narrower than the overall notification-performance concept.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Microbiological confirmation among notified TB patients
reviews.rationale: The construct aligns, but pooling requires the applicable diagnostic methods, cohort and period.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 8 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.conceptLabel: NAAT as initial TB diagnostic test
reviews.officialIndicatorName: Presumptive TB patients receiving NAAT as the initial diagnostic test
reviews.rationale: The manifestation directly represents the concept, but operational eligibility and referral completion must be verified.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 9 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Universal drug-susceptibility testing coverage
reviews.rationale: Overall coverage is closest to the concept but depends on the source-defined test bundle and cohort.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Rapid rifampicin DST coverage among notified TB patients
reviews.rationale: Rapid rifampicin testing is one step within the broader UDST pathway.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 17 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Rapid isoniazid DST coverage when rifampicin resistance is not detected
reviews.rationale: Rapid isoniazid testing for a restricted resistance subgroup is one step within UDST.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Bacteriologically confirmed patients without rifampicin resistance
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 18 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Fluoroquinolone DST coverage among isoniazid-monoresistant TB
reviews.rationale: Fluoroquinolone DST among Hr-TB is a restricted step within UDST.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 19 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: First- and second-line LPA coverage among MDR/RR-TB
reviews.rationale: Line-probe testing in MDR/RR-TB is one restricted step within UDST.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Bacteriologically confirmed patients with rifampicin resistance
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 20 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.conceptLabel: TB treatment success and sustained outcome
reviews.officialIndicatorName: Treatment success among notified TB patients
reviews.rationale: End-of-treatment success is one component of the broader sustained-outcome concept.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Total TB patients notified in the applicable cohort

reviews.conceptLabel: TB treatment success and sustained outcome
reviews.officialIndicatorName: Sustained treatment success 6 months after TB treatment completion
reviews.rationale: This manifestation is restricted to the six-month follow-up point.

reviews.conceptLabel: TB treatment success and sustained outcome
reviews.officialIndicatorName: Sustained treatment success 12 months after TB treatment completion
reviews.rationale: This manifestation is restricted to the twelve-month follow-up point.

reviews.conceptLabel: TB treatment success and sustained outcome
reviews.officialIndicatorName: Sustained treatment success 18 months after TB treatment completion
reviews.rationale: This manifestation is restricted to the eighteen-month follow-up point.

reviews.conceptLabel: TB treatment success and sustained outcome
reviews.officialIndicatorName: Sustained treatment success 24 months after TB treatment completion
reviews.rationale: This manifestation is restricted to the twenty-four-month follow-up point.

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Contacts of an index TB patient evaluated for TB disease or infection
reviews.rationale: The construct aligns; implementation requires verification of listed-contact, evaluation and completion rules.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Listed contacts of index TB patients
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 13 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Household children younger than five receiving TB preventive treatment
reviews.rationale: The manifestation is restricted to eligible household contacts younger than five.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Eligible household contacts younger than five

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Eligible newly enrolled PLHIV offered isoniazid preventive treatment
reviews.rationale: The manifestation is restricted to newly enrolled PLHIV eligible for isoniazid preventive treatment.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Newly enrolled PLHIV screened negative for active TB

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Operational microscopy facilities
reviews.rationale: Operational microscopy facilities are one readiness dimension.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 1 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Functional NAAT machines
reviews.rationale: Functional NAAT machines are one technology-readiness dimension.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 2 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: TDCs with laboratory technicians available on all working days
reviews.rationale: Laboratory-technician availability is one workforce-readiness dimension.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 3 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Microscopy facilities with at least one functional microscope
reviews.rationale: A functional microscope is one facility-readiness dimension.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 4 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: TDCs covered by an existing sample-transport mechanism
reviews.rationale: Sample transport is one diagnostic-network readiness dimension.
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 5 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: CBNAAT testing-capacity utilization
reviews.rationale: Utilization describes use of available capacity, not readiness alone.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Monthly testing capacity of available CBNAAT machines
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 6 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Truenat testing-capacity utilization
reviews.rationale: Utilization describes use of available capacity, not readiness alone.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Monthly testing capacity of available Truenat machines
reviews.sourcePage: EQA guidance, Chapter 6.2, indicator 7 or component, pp. 179-190

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Annual parasite incidence for malaria
differences: dependent on case detection and ABER
reviews.rationale: Annual parasite incidence is the programme manifestation; interpretation requires concurrent surveillance intensity.
reviews.denominatorPopulation: Population corresponding to the per 1,000 population rate

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Annual blood examination rate

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Dengue case fatality rate

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Kala-azar incidence

reviews.denominatorPopulation: Population corresponding to the per 10,000 population rate
reviews.sourceName: India — National Centre for Vector Borne Diseases Control programmes
reviews.sourcePage: See linked official source; page/table varies by edition

reviews.officialIndicatorName: Lymphatic-filariasis microfilaria rate
